sparse_data_treatment.limitations: captures finite-profile selectivity and joint-pattern uncertainty; unseen-pattern usage is backed off to all observed rows; model-response variability is not identified

statistical_uncertainty.limitations: Jeffreys beta summaries are marginal and pairwise diagnostics; they do not replace the joint outcome-pattern posterior or model Jev response drift

value_of_additional_profiling.limitations: approximate EVSI under exchangeable reviews, a smoothed outcome-pattern model, and root-n cost-uncertainty contraction; response variability and distribution shift are not modeled

monte_carlo_confidence.does_not_cover: posterior model misspecification, contraction error, Jev response drift, or held-out execution variability
monte_carlo_confidence.scope: finite predictive-scenario Monte Carlo error only

objective_consistency.decision_loss: expected cost regret versus the modeled minimum
objective_consistency.note: This is policy-constrained EVSI, not unconstrained expected-cost EVSI; risk gates determine which future action may be selected
objective_consistency.profiling_cost: expected USD cost of the next checkpoint

value_of_additional_profiling.unchanged_plan_value_interpretation: zero under the expected decision-loss objective: confidence without an action change has no execution-cost value
